# TRYAMM Confidentiality / Non-Use / Limited Non-Circumvention / IP Assignment Template

Status: TEMPLATE — COUNSEL REVIEW REQUIRED BEFORE SIGNATURE

This template is intentionally narrow. Enforceability varies by jurisdiction and relationship. It is not a substitute for legal advice.

## Parties
This Agreement is between `[TRYAMM LEGAL ENTITY]` ("Company") and `[COUNTERPARTY LEGAL NAME]` ("Recipient/Contributor"), effective `[DATE]`.

## 1. Purpose
The parties wish to evaluate or perform work relating to `[PROJECT / BUSINESS PURPOSE]`. Confidential Information may be used only for that Purpose.

## 2. Confidential Information
Confidential Information includes nonpublic product plans, source code, architecture, prompts, models, designs, business plans, pricing, financial information, customer/vendor information, unpublished creative works, security information, trade secrets, inventions and other information reasonably understood to be confidential.

Confidential Information does not include information that Recipient can document: (a) was publicly available without breach; (b) was lawfully known without confidentiality duty; (c) was lawfully received from a third party without confidentiality duty; or (d) was independently developed without use of Confidential Information.

## 3. Non-Disclosure
Recipient will not disclose Confidential Information except to authorized personnel or advisers who need it for the Purpose and are bound by confidentiality obligations at least as protective as these terms.

## 4. Non-Use
Recipient will not use Confidential Information for any purpose other than the Purpose, including to build or assist a competing product from protected confidential information.

## 5. Security
Recipient will use reasonable administrative, technical and physical safeguards appropriate to the sensitivity of the information and promptly report suspected unauthorized access or disclosure.

## 6. Compelled Disclosure
If legally compelled to disclose Confidential Information, Recipient will, to the extent legally permitted, provide prompt notice and reasonable cooperation so the Company may seek protective treatment.

## 7. Return / Destruction
Upon written request or termination, Recipient will return or destroy Confidential Information, except copies retained solely as required by law or automatic backup policy and remaining subject to confidentiality obligations.

## 8. Limited Non-Circumvention
For `[12/18/24]` months after a documented introduction made specifically for the Purpose, Recipient will not knowingly bypass the Company to enter a substantially similar transaction directly with a specifically identified counterparty introduced by the Company for that transaction, solely to avoid the Company's documented agreed compensation or role.

This clause does not restrict pre-existing relationships, independently sourced relationships, general market activity, public opportunities, or relationships not specifically documented as protected introductions. This section must be reviewed for enforceability in the governing jurisdiction.

## 9. No Reverse Engineering
To the extent permitted by applicable law, Recipient will not reverse engineer nonpublic prototypes, binaries, models, systems or confidential technical materials supplied solely for evaluation, except where such restriction is prohibited by law or an applicable open-source license.

## 10. Ownership of Existing Materials
Each party retains ownership of materials, inventions, software, music, designs, know-how and other IP owned or developed before this engagement or independently outside it ("Background IP"). No ownership transfers merely by disclosure.

## 11. Work Product / Assignment
For paid or otherwise agreed contributor work specifically identified in a Statement of Work, the parties intend eligible Work Product to be treated as work made for hire to the maximum extent legally permitted. To the extent ownership does not automatically vest in Company, Contributor hereby assigns to Company all transferable right, title and interest in the Work Product upon the agreed conditions/payment stated in the applicable Statement of Work.

`Work Product` means only deliverables expressly created for Company under an executed Statement of Work. It excludes Background IP and third-party materials.

## 12. Background IP License
If Contributor incorporates approved Background IP necessary to use the Work Product, Contributor grants Company a `[perpetual/worldwide/royalty-free or other negotiated]` license sufficient to use, modify, reproduce, distribute and exploit the Work Product as agreed. Any different commercial terms must be listed in the Statement of Work.

## 13. Third-Party / Open-Source Materials
Contributor must identify all third-party software, models, music, fonts, images, datasets, open-source components and other licensed materials before incorporating them. Contributor will not introduce terms that conflict with the Company's intended commercial use without written approval.

## 14. Credentials / Source Handoff
Contributor will provide Company-controlled access to agreed repositories, source files, design masters, deployment configuration, documentation and service credentials. Personal passwords must not be shared; ownership/admin access should be transferred through provider-supported controls.

## 15. Representations
Contributor represents that they have authority to enter this Agreement and, to their knowledge, the Work Product they deliver will not knowingly infringe third-party rights except for disclosed and approved third-party materials.

## 16. No Publicity
Neither party may use the other party's name, logo or confidential project details in marketing, case studies or public announcements without prior written permission, except where disclosure is legally required.

## 17. Term / Survival
This Agreement begins on the Effective Date. Confidentiality for ordinary confidential information survives for `[3–5]` years after disclosure/termination. Trade-secret obligations survive as long as the information remains a trade secret under applicable law. Assigned IP ownership survives permanently.

## 18. Remedies
The parties acknowledge that unauthorized disclosure or misuse may cause harm not fully compensable by money damages and that a party may seek lawful equitable relief, subject to applicable law and court discretion.

## 19. Governing Law / Venue
Governing law: `[STATE/COUNTRY]`.
Venue/dispute process: `[COURT / ARBITRATION LANGUAGE AFTER COUNSEL REVIEW]`.

## 20. Entire Agreement / Amendments
This Agreement and executed Statements of Work contain the parties' agreement on these subjects and may be modified only in a signed writing, including legally valid electronic signatures.
